name: zebracat
description: Create Zebracat AI videos from an idea, script, blog URL, or audio file — AI Video, Moving AI Images, AI Avatar, Stock Footage, and viral Brainrot. Generate avatars and reusable characters, clone voices, and translate finished videos into 170+ languages.

interface.shortDescription: AI videos, avatars, voice cloning, brainrot, and translation
interface.longDescription: Zebracat Skills turn an idea, script, blog post, or audio file into a finished video — AI Video (cinematic AI footage), Moving AI Images, AI Avatar presenters, Stock Footage, and viral Brainrot. Use zebracat-video as the producer (intent discovery, script, voice, visuals, render, deliver), zebracat-avatar to design reusable presenters and characters, zebracat-voice to browse or clone voices, zebracat-brainrot for subway-surfers / minecraft-parkour / italian-brainrot short-form, and zebracat-translate to dub finished videos into 170+ languages with captions.
defaultPrompt: Make a 30-second video about my product launch
